title: articles table insert failure leaves IPFS block GC-invisible
description: transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs:243-254: the articles table INSERT (step 3.5) uses INSERT OR IGNORE, which is correct for duplicate CIDs. But the surrounding error handling logs a warning and continues on DB failure: if IPFS write (step 1), msgid_map insert (step 2), and log appends (step 3) all succeed, but the articles table INSERT fails due to a transient DB error, the article exists in IPFS, msgid_map, and the group log, but is invisible to GC. The block stays in IPFS indefinitely because select_gc_candidates only queries the articles table. No recovery path exists — operator must notice the tracing::warn and manually reconcile. Fix: treat articles table insert failure as a hard pipeline error (return Err), or add a startup GC reconciliation pass that re-inserts missing articles table rows by scanning the group log.
